name: shared-worktree-build-concurrency
title: Crash-safe cross-platform build mutex + content-bound idempotent build (shared-worktree review pipeline)
description: Deferred from B-fb7b (DONE, merged ba067c2f76). B-fb7bs FIRST Codex cross-host review found two MAJOR build-concurrency bugs (a lock age-steal of a live holder; an rm-during-read reader-writer race); after B-fb7b fixed those, a SECOND Codex review of the fix found two more MAJOR bugs (a check-then-delete reclaim TOCTOU race; mtime/existence freshness misclassifying deleted-source orphans, partial builds, and tampered outputs). All four are recorded in B-fb7bs cross_host_review verdicts. B-fb7b then fully reverted its build-lock attempt and shipped only a minimal existence-based bootstrap, so the build currently has NO locking. This story ADDS the robust fix: (a) a cross-platform proper-lockfile mutex around the build critical section; (b) a content-bound skip using the EXISTING scripts/full-suite-build-binding.mjs verifyBuildBinding (sha256 over all packages/main src+config and all dist outputs) instead of mtime/existence, plus an analogous packages/utils binding; applied to the three distinct build call sites (scripts/ensure-dist.mjs, scripts/build-main-with-binding.mjs which is also the packages-main-build validate command, and the packages/utils build).
source: descoped from B-fb7b two-round cross-host (Codex) review
